concept: No Refunds, variant B: 18s silent-readable Maya & Ethan Short; only the final 3s framing differs between A and B

shots.title: Coupon book slide
shots.action: Ethan, beaming, slides a homemade sticky-note chore coupon book across the kitchen counter to Maya. Biscuit sits on the floor, frame right, watching.
shots.shot_scale: medium-wide two-shot, both humans waist-up, Biscuit visible full-body at floor level
props: coupon book (blank sticky-note pages, no generated text)
shots.onscreen_text_in_post: 1 FREE DISHWASH (top coupon, added in edit; must be readable muted by 2.0s)

shots.title: Maya redeems one
shots.action: Maya tears out the top coupon and hands it straight back to Ethan, expectant.
shots.shot_scale: medium single on Maya, Ethan's hand entering frame

shots.title: The tiny print
shots.action: Close insert: Ethan's finger taps the tiny print at the bottom of the coupon.
shots.shot_scale: insert close-up on coupon and fingertip
shots.onscreen_text_in_post: EXPIRED (tiny print on coupon, composited in edit)
shots.production_note: Candidate for a local owned still or practical photo + composited text: no generation needed.

shots.title: Every page expired
shots.action: Maya flips through the book: every page is stamped. Ethan crouches and offers the whole book to Biscuit with both hands.
shots.shot_scale: medium two-shot, then Ethan drops to dog level within the same frame
props: coupon book (stamp shapes blank; text added in edit)
shots.onscreen_text_in_post: EXPIRED stamps on each flipped page

shots.title: Biscuit returns it
shots.action: Biscuit takes the book in its mouth, drops it at Ethan's feet and turns away.
shots.shot_scale: wide shared frame: Maya, crouching Ethan and Biscuit all full-body
shots.production_note: Highest-risk shot (dog mouth/object continuity). Generate first; if it fails QA twice, switch to a practical/composited cue as the research note allows.

shots.title: Ethan close reaction
shots.action: Cut to an isolated close-up of Ethan's face, still crouched, as Biscuit walks off unseen; he holds a deadpan defeated look.
shots.camera: static, at Ethan's crouched eye line
